cross_process_resume.probe: asset-manager/probe-memory-resume.mjs (new; HUB_MEMORY_RESUME_BUNDLE=1 switches to the generated session-default run package via dsh-bundle)
cross_process_resume.mechanism: Process 1 runs DSH headless --json (fresh persisted session), writes a tip, triggers an auto observation, recalls in-process, exits. Process 2 (separate OS process, new model server, new patch layer) resumes with --session-id <same id>; its FIRST action is memory_net_recall, then raw view, then a second write.
cross_process_resume.scope_note: Session scope directory is workspaces_root/scoped-v1/p-<sha(project)>/s-<sha(sessionId)>; resume reuses it (single directory asserted), attribution stays run_id/task_id == sessionId, and the default 'main' workspace is never created in session mode. Bundle variant boots the generated session-default run package (dsh-bundle --memory) through its own patch layer; verifyDshBundle passes after state changes (state growth does not invalidate the run-copy verification).

multitask_ab.arms: curated task-driven recall (recallForTask) vs recent-first raw snapshot (same node budget) on a fixed 6-task set with seeded constraints/tips/promoted inferences/progress plus word-overlap noise and latest-log noise
